meta.name: TVF Bachelors
meta.description:
The series revolves around Four Bachelor Flatmates who in every episode will deal with a specific daily life bachelor related problem. Its about their battle against an external X problem as a single team The Bachelors.

Returning Series · First aired 15 Jun 2016 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: YouTube, TVFPlay 

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5 | S3 not on server

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Bachelors Vs Ghost ft. BB ki Vines
videos.overview: This is the story of a bhoot who lives in an apartment which is haunted by bachelors.

videos.title: Bachelors vs Landlord ft. BB ki Vines
videos.overview: What happens if Bachelors are challenged by their flat owner to clean every corner of the house before Diwali? If they succeed to do so, they'll be exempted from next three months rent. But if they fail, they'll have to pay "3 Gunaa Rent".

videos.title: Bachelors vs Dry Day ft. BB ki Vines
videos.overview: What happens if Bachelors are challenged by their flat owner to clean every corner of the house before Diwali? If they succeed to do so, they'll be exempted from next three months rent. But if they fail, they'll have to pay "3 Gunaa Rent".

videos.title: Bachelors vs Early Morning ft. BB ki Vines
videos.overview: Bachelors challenge Dr Mastana after the latter insults them for not waking up early in the morning.

videos.title: Ek Din Ka Professor
videos.overview: BB accepts a challenge by professor Chauhan to run the college for one day.

videos.title: Bachelors Vs Jobs
videos.overview: After getting fired from his job, Jeetu takes up the challenge to find his engineer friends a job against all odds.

videos.title: Bachelors vs Month End
videos.overview: It's that time of the month for Bachelors. The time when everything from food to sutta looks unattainable. This is Bachelors vs Month End

videos.title: Bachelors vs Cooking
videos.overview: Badri's mom comes to town in this epic saga with Butter Chicken, Rajma and Gordon Ramsay.

videos.title: Bahubully: The Beginning
videos.overview: In an Indian Hostel, an adventurous and daring man becomes involved in a decades old feud between two sides. Who will win? This is Bahubully: The Beginning.

videos.title: Bahubully 2: The Conclusion
videos.overview: Shivappa tells the painful ordeal which lead to deceitful expulsion of Bahubully and how Shivappa was forced to orchestrate it. Jeetu decides to take it up on himself to reveal the truth and banish Dahi Bhalla.
